name: @slincnik/simplehttp
description: Browser-only, zero-dependency HTTP client built on native Fetch.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2020 --minify --sourcemap=external --outfile=dist/index.js
scripts.test: pnpm run build && node --test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && pnpm run check:size
scripts.size: pnpm run build && pnpm run check:size
scripts.check:size: node -e "const z=require('node:zlib').gzipSync(require('node:fs').readFileSync('dist/index.js')).length; console.log(z+' bytes gzip'); if(z>3072) process.exit(1)"
